# Data Source UNIX group

Retrieves the specified UNIX group in the SVM

## Related ONTAP commands

```commandline
* vserver services name-service unix-group show
```

## Supported Platforms

* On-prem ONTAP system 9.9 or higher
* Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netapp-ontap_unix_group" "unix_group" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "hw-cluster"
  name = "root"
  svm_name = "svm1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name
- `name` (String) The name of the UNIX group.
- `svm_name` (String) The name of the SVM.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) UNIX group ID of the specified group.
- `users` (Set of String) The list of users associated with the UNIX group.
